sources.title: Ornith-1.5 — open MIT model matches Claude Opus… | AI/TLDR
sources.snippet: Ornith-1.5 is a family of open-weight models released under MIT in 397B and 35B mixture-of-experts and 9B dense sizes. The 397B scores 86.1 on Terminal-Bench 2.1 against 85.0 for Claude Opus 4.8. An open-weight model family that writes its own training tasks, then trains on them.
